--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -0,0 +1,159 @@
+# ESP32 Room Environmental Monitor
+
+A comprehensive ESP32-based room monitoring system with temperature, humidity, and light sensing, plus a web dashboard for configuration and monitoring.
+
+## Features
+
+- **Environmental Monitoring**:
+  - DHT22 temperature/humidity sensor on GPIO27
+  - LDR analog light sensor on GPIO34
+  - SSD1306 128x64 I2C OLED display (SDA21/SCL22)
+  - Status LED on GPIO26
+  - Alert acknowledge button on GPIO25 (INPUT_PULLUP)
+
+- **Smart Alerting**:
+  - Configurable temperature/humidity/light thresholds with hysteresis
+  - Visual and LED alerts when thresholds are exceeded
+  - Button press to acknowledge alerts
+
+- **Web Dashboard**:
+  - Access Point mode for easy initial setup
+  - Live JSON status API
+  - Interactive HTML dashboard with real-time updates
+  - Threshold configuration via web interface
+  - Demo mode for testing without sensors
+  - Preferences persistence across reboots
+
+- **Robust Design**:
+  - Non-blocking millis() based timing
+  - Button debouncing
+  - Graceful sensor error handling
+  - Hysteresis to prevent alert chattering
+
+## Hardware Connections
+
+| Component | ESP32 GPIO | Notes |
+|-----------|------------|-------|
+| DHT22 Data | GPIO27 | Temperature/Humidity sensor |
+| LDR Signal | GPIO34 | Analog light sensor (VP) |
+| OLED SDA | GPIO21 | I2C data line |
+| OLED SCL | GPIO22 | I2C clock line |
+| Status LED | GPIO26 | With current limiting resistor |
+| Button | GPIO25 | INPUT_PULLUP for active-low button |
+| OLED VCC | 3.3V | Power |
+| OLED GND | GND | Ground |
+| DHT22 VCC | 3.3V | Power |
+| DHT22 GND | GND | Ground |
+| LDR VCC | 3.3V | Through resistor to form voltage divider |
+| LDR GND | GND | Through resistor to form voltage divider |
+
+*Note: The LDR should be part of a voltage divider circuit connected to GPIO34 (VP pin which is analog-only)*
+
+## Libraries Required
+
+- `adafruit/Adafruit Unified Sensor@1.1.15`
+- `adafruit/DHT sensor library@1.4.7`
+- `adafruit/Adafruit SSD1306@2.5.17`
+- `esp32async/ESPAsyncWebServer@3.12.1`
+- `esp32async/AsyncTCP@3.5.0`
+- `bblanchon/ArduinoJson@7.4.3`
+
+PlatformIO installs these automatically from `platformio.ini`. `Preferences`,
+`WiFi`, and `Wire` are supplied by the Arduino-ESP32 framework.
+
+## Setup Instructions
+
+1. **Hardware Assembly**:
+   - Connect components according to the pinout table above
+   - Ensure proper pull-up resistors for I2C (4.7kΩ typical)
+   - Use appropriate current limiting resistor for LED (220-470Ω)
+   - Button should be wired to ground when pressed (uses internal pull-up)
+
+2. **Software Setup**:
+   - Install PlatformIO IDE or use PlatformIO Core CLI
+   - Clone this repository
+   - PlatformIO will automatically install required libraries
+   - Build and upload the firmware
+
+3. **First Use**:
+   - On power up, the ESP32 will start in Access Point mode
+   - Connect to WiFi network: "ESP32-Room-Monitor"
+   - Password: "roommonitor123"
+   - Open browser to http://192.168.4.1
+   - Configure thresholds as needed
+   - To connect to your home WiFi, modify the code to include WiFi credentials
+
+## Web Dashboard
+
+### API Endpoints
+
+- `GET /` - Main HTML dashboard
+- `GET /status` - Current sensor readings and system status (JSON)
+- `POST /thresholds` - Save new threshold values (JSON)
+- `POST /demo-toggle` - Enable/disable demo mode
+- `POST /acknowledge` - Acknowledge active alerts
+
+### Dashboard Features
+
+- Real-time sensor readings display
+- Visual alert status indication
+- Configurable thresholds for all sensors
+- Demo mode toggle for testing
+- Alert acknowledge button
+- Current WiFi mode display
+
+## Demo Mode
+
+Set `#define DEMO_MODE true` in the code or use the web dashboard to enable demo mode. This simulates sensor data allowing you to test:
+- Web dashboard functionality
+- Alert triggering and acknowledgment
+- Threshold adjustments
+- Display updates
+- All system features without physical sensors
+
+## Behavior
+
+### Normal Operation
+- Reads DHT22 every 2 seconds
+- Continuously monitors LDR analog input
+- Updates OLED display with readings and status
+- Controls status LED based on alert state
+- Maintains Access Point for web configuration
+
+### Alert System
+- Monitors temperature, humidity, and light against thresholds
+- Uses hysteresis to prevent rapid alert toggling:
+  - Temperature: ±1.0°C hysteresis
+  - Humidity: ±5.0% hysteresis  
+  - Light: ±100 units hysteresis
+- Activates status LED and displays alert on OLED when thresholds exceeded
+- Button press (or web acknowledge) clears alert state
+
+### Error Handling
+- If DHT22 fails to read, displays "Sensor Error" and retains last valid values
+- Continues operation even if display fails to initialize
+- Web dashboard remains functional regardless of sensor status
+
+## Configuration
+
+Threshold values are stored in ESP32 Preferences and persist across reboots:
+- Temperature High: 28.0°C (default)
+- Temperature Low: 18.0°C (default)
+- Humidity High: 70.0% (default)
+- Humidity Low: 30.0% (default)
+- Light High: 3000 (default)
+- Light Low: 500 (default)
+
+## Power Considerations
+
+- Designed for continuous operation
+- Typical power consumption: ~80-120mA during normal operation
+- Access Point mode increases consumption slightly
+- Consider deep sleep modes for battery operation (not implemented in this version)
+
+## Customization
+
+- Adjust `DHT_READ_INTERVAL` for different sampling rates
+- Modify hysteresis values in #define statements for different sensitivity
+- Change OLED I2C pins if needed by modifying OLED_SDA/OLED_SCL
+- Adjust web server port by changing the AsyncWebServer constructor parameter

--- a/platformio.ini

+[env:esp32dev]
+platform = espressif32@7.1.3
+board = esp32dev
+framework = arduino
+monitor_speed = 115200
+
+lib_deps =
+    adafruit/Adafruit Unified Sensor@1.1.15
+    adafruit/DHT sensor library@1.4.7
+    adafruit/Adafruit SSD1306@2.5.17
+    esp32async/ESPAsyncWebServer@3.12.1
+    esp32async/AsyncTCP@3.5.0
+    bblanchon/ArduinoJson@7.4.3
